newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: USAID GIVES HUMANITARIAN AID TO S.LANKA NGOS.
newsitem.headline: USAID GIVES HUMANITARIAN AID TO S.LANKA NGOS.

text.p: The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) said on Thursday that it had granted 30 million rupees ($510,000) to four non-governmental organisations (NGOs) in Sri Lanka for humanitarian assistance

It said in a statement said Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) of France had been given five million rupees to co-fund specialised medical care and training programmes at the Jaffna Teaching Hospital, the largest hospital in the north of Sri Lanka.
Don Bosco Technical Center will receive five million rupees for its rehabilitation work for children at risk in the fishing communities on Sri Lanka's west coast.

The statement said the remaining 20 million rupees will be given to the Community Front for the Prevention of Aids (CFPA) and to the Sri Lanka Association for Voluntary Surgical Contraception (SLAVSC) for their work on AIDS awareness.
